learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of Phase Lag and Synchrony.
Apply Phase Lag and Synchrony to technically valid clinical interpretation.
Identify artifacts, confounds and limits that could alter conclusions.
Communicate findings without exceeding the evidence or professional scope.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: Phase-based measures estimate whether oscillations maintain consistent timing differences.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: Filtering, reference, volume conduction and low signal-to-noise ratio can distort phase. Non-zero-lag metrics reduce some but not all confounds.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Helps evaluate claims about timing and network coordination.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: A phase map alone cannot establish direction or causality.
